Thirteen slices: I1-I4 (the instruments first: NIGHT67-REPORT.md section 7, history.md, levels-data.md), seven rooms on three levels (builder S: level 3 kb3c kb2 kb3d; builder R: level 2 g8, level 5 v2, level 3 kb3, and level 2 g7 melee only behind its probe: the forge's call at GG's 'you make the calls'), LV (branch A / A-lean only) and PC (always a labelled play build). A doneWhen is written before any measurement and never loosened; only the lead edits this file. Each room's verb, mainBar and ceilings are written by the lead from its red on I1-I4 before its first round is judged.
ROOM: an area card first (Research/2026-10-24-wave67/cards/<id>.md, <= 40 lines): the archetype (research.md section 2, one per room), the room's verb (one the verb pilot performs AND fires in this room with its loadout: the card cites the bearings' probe line), the lever that makes refusing the verb cost time, health or score, each piece and its job, the lint rules the shipped room fails and how the card fixes each, the aims for M1-M4; one card critic pass, its open items round 1's list
the rebuilt room file carries `verb65` (equal to the slate's verb) and `line65` (the verb's line from the entry), never an `area67` block (the assembler refuses unknown fields)

a GATE needs M1-M4 and every GUARD held on one main-tree round on the passed tools, skip v2 also on fresh seeds 21-30 (the GATE pack's fresh skip, or the r1 pre-run it takes by --fresh; a pack whose fresh line names seed 11 is refused by the critic), the room file unchanged since that round, and that round read by a level review written at its named time (NIGHT68.md section 4: a fresh reviewer starts the moment the round ends; NIGHT67 never wrote one, so no room could have passed); a room without such a round is SHORT

M1 AREA: `node Tools/night/n68-area.cjs --level <L> --dir <the round's folder> --touches <the round's verbs-skip.txt> <room>` passes every rule that applies (a rule with nothing to judge prints N/A): OPEN no open floor square larger than 12 x 12 m with no piece in it (gg-proxy's 'empty boxes'); P1 a plane 3.5 m or higher holds the last wave's ranged enemies (N/A with no ranged enemy); P4 every solid 1.75 m or taller does a job by the decoration checker; P5 at least half the walk line's samples in a ranged spawn's sight at 6-24 m and line65's share at least 0.3 lower, or line65 within 6 m of an enemy; P9 every plane 6 m or wider has at least 2 enemy climb routes with tops 8 m or more apart; P11 for a TOWER, GALLERY or SPLIT LEVEL card, every ranged spawn on a high node 2.5 m or more up and 12-24 m from the walk lane; P17 every ride wall 4 m or taller and 8 m or longer with the cyan strip, no non-ride wall in that band

M2 VERB: skip v2 on the room's verb, POOLED over seeds 1-20 (the median of 20; the per-set ratios printed beside it), prints a ratio >= the room's mainBar = max(1.25, its red's pooled ratio + 0.20) with >= 14 of 20 seeds exercised and the refused run's refusal fired (`refused <verb> N` with N > 0 on every exercised seed: the ride refusal leaked on 10 / 10 in g8 and kb3c at NIGHT67); STYLE above DULL on the verb-aware run >= min(refusal + 15, max(refusal, 95)) (FORGE68 and its red team 10: the +15 rule alone was unreachable on kb3 80.1 % and v6 88.6 %, levels-data.md item 2, and a step at 80 % would reward a more stylish refusal); a ride room whose ratio is in [mainBar, mainBar + 0.10) is UNSURE and does not PASS M2; on the GATE pack's fresh seeds 21-30 (never tuned on) the median ratio >= 1.25 and >= 7 of 10 exercised (the verb still the faster line on seeds the builder never saw)

M3: the room's verb pilot GREEN on line65 (ride: a kill from the wall, `n65verb ride --shoot`; launch: 'in a pit yes' or 'in lava yes' on the launched body; parry: a returned glob kills a spitter; slide: the slide line's kill; pierce: >= 2 bodies)

M4: every piece of the rebuilt room passes the decoration checker (its base the room file's first commit), and at least one collider piece was added with a job; a round's change counts only by a double-or-half (a piece added or removed, or one geometry number x2 / x0.5)

GUARDS, no worse than the shipped room (its red; the ceilings in this slate: deathsAMax, deathsBMax, stallAMax): the walk bot (n46flow seeds 1-10 and 11-20) clears 10 / 10, deaths A / B and stall A at or under the ceilings; no room-check item fails that passed in the shipped room; air65's flights handed on; levelgen ERROR rows no more than the base level's own; the room's spawn never moved toward the verb's line
the blind SPOT (a fresh skygrind-spotter on the GATE pack's spot-A / spot-B) names the piece that serves the verb; a skygrind-critic PASS on the GATE round
